changelog:
Initial release of aws-fis-experiment-execute.

- Allows users to run a prepared AWS FIS (Fault Injection Simulator) experiment using an existing, already-deployed CloudFormation stack.
- Supports both English and Chinese language detection for all output.
- Verifies experiment directory and stack status before execution; does not deploy any infrastructure.
- Performs pre-experiment health checks on all targeted AWS resources.
- Integrates with the app-service-log-analysis sub-skill for application log collection and analysis.
- Guides the user through monitoring the experiment, analyzing results, and generating a final report.
summary: Use when the user wants to run a prepared AWS FIS experiment where the CloudFormation stack has already been deployed. Triggers on "execute FIS experiment",...
